title: Enveda CASMI 2026 v2-A7 E2E
subtitle: Frozen CASMI 2026 spectrum-to-SMILES ranking runtime
description: Private frozen inference package for CASMI 2026. Includes the v2-A7 reference library, five frozen LightGBM ranking folds, A7 MOST_CONFIDENT_SPECTRUM aggregation/calibration, self-test fixtures, frozen scientific inference code, and the lightweight runtime orchestration needed for offline Kaggle inference.
